nom: Naked Sundays CabanaMilk Mineral Barrier Fluid SPF 50

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin frequently describe the product as too greasy or shiny, some needing powder to set it, though a few oily-skinned reviewers report it worked fine under makeup with light setting.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the fluid as hydrating, glowy and non-drying, with several saying it suits dry skin better than oily skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report a lightweight, non-greasy feel overall, though some note extra shine in the T-zone that they manage with powder.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no stinging, irritation or flare-ups and calming, soothing wear, though one notes watery eyes on first application and another experienced eye sting.
segments.mature: One reviewer highlights daily use for anti-aging protection without the typical sunscreen smell, but mature skin is otherwise not discussed in detail.

concerns.aging: One reviewer uses it specifically for daily anti-aging sun protection and appreciates the lack of typical SPF smell; no other aging-specific outcomes are reported.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the product as hydrating and moisturizing, leaving skin feeling nourished rather than dry; one reviewer contrasts it favorably with a prior tinted sunscreen that left skin dry and flaky.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness report it covers or calms redness somewhat and did not cause new redness even after sun exposure, with no reports of worsened redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the product with supporting or repairing the skin barrier and note it feels skincare-like rather than like a typical sunscreen.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with melasma reports it is the first tinted mineral sunscreen that didn't turn orange on her skin, but spots/pigmentation are otherwise not addressed.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no breakouts and find it non-irritating; however, one reviewer with cystic acne attributes a breakout to the product's oil content, and another mentions a single spot appearing when not washed off before bed.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin split sharply: several find it too greasy, heavy, or shine-inducing and needing powder, while others with oily or combination skin report it wears matte-ish or manageable throughout the day.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under makeup without pilling
High price for small bottle size

extraits.texte: I have medium oily/combination skin and this product just enhanced that oil. The sunscreen itself did not break me out which is a plus, but it is so greasy. You can just feel this on your skin. Would only recommend if you have dry skin.

This is the first year I've really decided to use sunscreen regularly. I have melasma, so I require a tinted mineral sunscreen. This is the first one I've tried that is tinted but doesn't make me look orange. There's no scent. It's nice and thin and weightless. It even helps repair the skin barrier! I have acne-prone skin and have only noticed a single spot pop up when I didn't wash it off at the end of the day. I did knock a star off because it does get kind of oily, gritty feeling towards the end of the day. But it's the best sunscreen I've found so far! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

extraits.titre: Wasn't sure at first but now it's my daily spf!
extraits.texte: BIG FAN of this sunscreen! While it feels greasy when first applying, it dries pretty quickly, is lightweight, and has a subtle scent. It doesn't dry out my sensitive, acne-prone skin, and is incredibly hydrating, like a skincare step. No breakouts or sensitivity! Ordering another bottle!

I have loved naked Sundays since day 1. Ive tried out quite a few products from them. I was so excited when I was chosen for this round to try out a new unreleased product. I was out of town for 1 week straight and used this product most of the time on my vacation with and without wearing any makeup since my skin was horribly breaking out with cystic acne for the first time ever which was hard to control. Instead of packing on makeup on my cystic acne breakouts I decided just go wash my face and apply this beautiful dewy primer SPF. I thought maybe after the first time trying this product it's what caused my cystic acne breakouts which was so accurate for me. This lotion was tinted which I loved as well but it was extremely oily for me too. Skincare products which contain more oil are known to cause breakouts. I know this because of common knowledge and I just graduated medical esthetics school. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have been loving this! It works amazingly as a primer under my makeup. It instantly hydrates my skin, and my makeup literally glides on. I especially love this as someone with combination – dry skin. On no-makeup days, I love wearing it on its own because it gives my skin such a glow without looking oily or greasy. I have also not had any issues with breakouts, even with my acne prone skin! I am obsessed with the packaging, and it is so easy to toss in my bag for reapplication throughout the day. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I received this as a part of an educational promotion. I tried the tinted sunscreen for two weeks and it's now a part of my everyday routine. I had used a different tinted sunscreen and it made my skin feel dry and flaky. This one is so hydrating, and leaves my skin feeling moisturized and glowy. I've tried applying with my hands and a brush and I prefer applying this with a brush for more coverage since it's a bit sheer. Color wise I feel like the tint has a perfect neutral shade. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have very sensitive eyes and very sensitive skin, but I also have very pale skin, so finding something that works as a skin tint that doesn't bother my eyes and doesn't bother my skin is always a feet. However, I truly enjoyed this product. I like that it can be worn alone and covers a little bit of my redness while making me feel protective from the sun, but also can be worn underneath a full face of foundation and not pill or disturb the products that I put on top. I only took away one star just because upon initial application it did make my eyes a little watery, but it didn't sting so that's a benefit. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.
